lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: *Knock knock*

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Anyone there?
Long time no see.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Oh, Commander!

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm touched that you'd remember

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: a nobody like me all the way from the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: How have you been?
It's been rough.
Doing great.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Oh, sorry to hear that.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: There's a light at the end of the tunnel.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Things will get better.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Glad to hear it.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I have some good news as well,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: so I wanted to send you a message.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Nothing special.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: After what you did for me,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I was able to finish my treatment,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and now I can get back to work.
So no problems with the leg?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Hee-hee.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I traded it for something better.
What?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: My leg was too far gone to save, so off it went!

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Then the doctors swapped it for some Nikke parts

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and 2nd generation parts at that! What's more, my body didn't reject them.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So it's as good as new now! Hehe.
Sounds like you've been through a lot.
Good for you.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I didn't make you uncomfortable, did I?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm sorry if I did.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I think it's fantastic, and I wanted to tell you about it.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: This new robot leg is way better. That decrepit old leg of mine had to go.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: would you be interested in going up to the surface with me?
Why the surface?
Why together?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I came across a promising lead.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: But you've got to keep it on the down-low.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: My friend told me you can make a fortune up there.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It's all above board too.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: The Central Government is even encouraging people to do it.
Something's not right...

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You're just skittish because you've been duped one too many times before.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'll handle everything.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: All you have to do is do me a small favor,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and you'll get yourself a sweet reward.
I need more explanation.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: We can talk more up on the surface.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You can find me at these coordinates.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'll see you there.
